findings.claim: The TASK-0006 prompt tells the worker to include MOD-ddl-35 for F-09 (OD-R25-007) and MOD-ddl-39 for F-15 (OD-R25-011). Both ODs are still open. plan.md lists the OD-R25-007 decider as Owner and the OD-R25-011 decider as Architect + Owner, and the only recommendation given is (a). The prompt makes only the suspicion deadline, alternate order, publication state and uncatalogued errors source_pending. It does not treat F-09's decider roles (rait-chair + rait-signing-authority vs. rait-chair alone) as pending, and it does not carry the general rule from TASK-0003.md:27-28 ('não escolha papel, prazo, coluna ou evento por inferência'). A worker could write the Architect's recommendation (a) as fact for the F-09 roles and for the published_at/published_by columns, which item 3 forbids.
findings.fix: In TASK-0006.md, add after line 27: 'Decisão do Owner ainda aberta (OD-R25-007 papéis/decisor de F-09; OD-R25-011 forma de publicação de F-15) ou fonte ausente = `source_pending`/fail-closed com a OD; não escolha papel, prazo, coluna ou evento por inferência; a recomendação do Architect não é aprovação.' Then recompute the sha256 and pc_id of TASK-0006 in compositions.json and TASK-0006.json.

findings.claim: The prompt allows only 'namespaces existentes e permitidos' but does not name the source of the allowlist. That source is docs/framework/arch/parameter-catalogue.md §Namespaces i18n (line 134), and plan.md line 79 requires the 'namespaces allowlistados'. A worker running Luna on low effort could read 'existentes' as 'permitidos'.
findings.fix: Cite `docs/framework/arch/parameter-catalogue.md` §Namespaces i18n as the source of the allowlist (read-only). Say that a key outside the allowlist stops the task and is recorded as a blocker. Update the hash.

findings.claim: The acceptance command checks only OD-R25-001, 002 and 015, but the prompt (line 26) requires OD-R25-001…015. It also does not check the RAIT-WEB — R-0025 section. TASK-0003 and TASK-0006 likewise check only the endpoints (F-01/F-05/A-6 and F-06/F-16), not every F-nn/A-n.
findings.fix: Use a loop: `for n in $(seq -w 1 15); do rg -q "OD-R25-0$n" ... || exit 1; done` plus `rg -q 'RAIT-WEB — R-0025'`. Do the same for F-01..F-05, A-1..A-6 and F-06..F-16 in the contracts.

findings.claim: All four JSONs use `bash -lc` in acceptance_commands, but law/schemas/task.schema.json describes this field as 'Literal shell-free argv arrays'. The schema only requires string[], and there is precedent (R-0005…R-0010), so verify:round-tasks passes.
findings.fix: Optional: move the checks into shell-free argv (for example `node -e` or a verification script), or record the deviation as a maestro decision in plan.md.

findings.claim: The prompt asks for 'chaves no formato de dados de R-0023', but R-0023 is not in origin/main (d8c5d72a), so no versioned source exists for that format yet.
findings.fix: State that the key format follows the R-0023 plan as a proposal marked `source_pending` (R-0023), to be rechecked when the round resumes. Apply the same to TASK-0006.md line 28.
